script: Meet the bottle that goes everywhere you go. It is made of double-walled steel, so your water stays cold for a full day and your tea stays hot all morning. The lid is leak-proof, so you can throw it in your bag without worry. It is easy to clean, and it replaces hundreds of plastic bottles every year. Take it to the gym, the office, or a long hike in the hills. Stay refreshed and waste less.
